title: Marlowe & Finch Cardmember Benefit — Price-Accuracy Credit Cap on Merchandise Purchases
content:
A Marlowe & Finch cardmember's price-accuracy credit on a Price Accuracy Promise correction of a Merchandise Purchases unit is capped according to the cards the customer holds in the Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards program.

| Cards held (Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards accounts) | Accuracy credit cap |
|---|---|
| an active Marlowe & Finch Store Card Elite or World Elite Mastercard | premium accuracy credit cap, $40.00 |
| any other active Marlowe & Finch card (Store Card, Store Card Plus, Mastercard, Platinum Mastercard) | cardmember accuracy credit cap, $25.00 |

The first row governs whenever it holds, even if other cards are also held. A customer holding no active Marlowe & Finch card is outside this benefit. A card that is not active (restricted or closed) does not count.

## Cases (hypothetical holdings)

| Active cards on record | Cap |
|---|---|
| Store Card Elite | $40.00 |
| Store Card Plus and World Elite Mastercard | $40.00 |
| Platinum Mastercard only | $25.00 |
| Store Card closed, nothing else | outside this benefit |

With a credit of $30.00 before the cap (hypothetical), the premium cap leaves $30.00 and the cardmember cap reduces it to $25.00.
